blocks.text: Part D: the four things that cause real trouble

c.v: In order of how often they catch small South African businesses:

items.v: Not filing when you earn nothing. Penalties grow monthly on nil returns you never submitted. A dormant company is the worst version of this.
Trading before a required licence is issued. You cannot apply retrospectively, and you can be fined.
Charging VAT without being registered. This is fraud, not a mistake.
Mixing business and personal money. It makes every other problem on this list harder to fix.
